hooks.command:
.venv/Scripts/python.exe -c "import json,sys,subprocess,os
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
f=d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path') or d.get('tool_response',{}).get('filePath')
if f and f.endswith('.py'):
    exe=os.path.join(os.path.dirname(sys.executable),'ruff.exe')
    subprocess.run([exe,'format',f])
"
